Messages.Author: Robert C Campbell Jr
Messages.Body:
I'm sorry I'm being such a pest with all this, but this oot stuff just
totally screws the rules.

I got this predator. Call him Mike Shirk (the gangrel dude, for you atlanta
guys) for the sake of argument. I got a Madness out, and Zebulon rushes one
of his dudes at the end of his minion phase. Is he allowed to play reaction
cards on his turn, in response to my rush? If so, can he play Sudden
Reversal to kill the Rotscscrwreck?

Question number too: (PAY ATTENTION LEGBITER)
Has anyone thought about running this little sweetness:

Picture if you will:
Madness is out
Zebulon is out
He's got a homonculus
He's got an Aaron's Feeding Razor
He's got a shit-ton of blood dolls on him

Think about it for a second.

The actions it takes to get the Aaron's on Zeb is well worth the 3 or 4
blood per turn he could gain from hunting. I played a weekened version of
malkey oot tonight (sac lamb style) and ended up untapping with my
homonculus only to hunt later several times. Got three points in a 5 person
game, though, and should have got more..

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Robert C Campbell Jr" <bj...@mindspring.com> wrote:

> I got a Madness out, and Zebulon rushes one of [player X's] dudes at the end
> of [player X's] minion phase. Is [player X] allowed to play reaction

> cards on his turn, in response to my rush?

Yes. Reaction cards do not care whose turn it is. Your minions can play
reaction cards on any action taken by another Methuselah's minion.

> If so, can he play Sudden
> Reversal to kill the Rotscscrwreck?

No. Sudden Reversal is an out-of-turn Master card (not a reaction card).
Out-of-turn Master cards cannot be played on your own turn.

Messages.Author: Patrick Harris
Messages.Body:
>>Yes. Reaction cards do not care whose turn it is. Your minions can play reaction cards on any action taken by another Methuselah's minion.<<

How doese this work?
If this is the case, can I play reaction cards on my turn to help out my acting vamp?

case 1  If it is my turn can I call a vote with one vamp and play a reaction with another?

case 2  If it is my prays turn and I call a vote via madness net, can I play reaction cards with my other vamps?

I think, I can not do the first and I can do the second, but I would the offical answer.

"Your minions can play reaction cards on any action taken by another Methuselah's minion."

So I think the answer would be no to both of your examples, as they both involve your minion(s) reacting to actions taken by your minion(s).
